steps.title: Combining
steps.say: `&&` is **and** (both true), `||` is **or** (at least one), `!` is **not** (flip it).

board.code:
hasComms && !eStopped    // comms AND not e-stopped
day.equals("Saturday") || day.equals("Sunday")

steps.title: Comparing Strings
steps.say: Use `.equals(...)` for Strings, not `==`. `==` asks "same object?", which is usually not what you mean.

board.code:
day.equals("Sunday")   // compares the text
day == "Sunday"        // compares objects: unreliable

steps.title: Ternary
steps.say: `condition ? a : b` is a one-line if/else that **gives back a value**.

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.
